notes: Air Plus SoC options on the official page: Ryzen 7 6800U, Ryzen 3 7320U, Ryzen 5 7520U, Intel Core i3-1215U, Intel Pentium 8505 (NotebookCheck says the 8505 edition was cancelled). Only the 6800U has a file in data/socs/. Pre-order price for the 6800U 16GB/512GB was $779 (official page and NotebookCheck); the Advance 32GB/2TB was $1,179. NotebookCheck (2023-02-28) gave early May 2023 as the 6800U shipping start; release month is that planned date, not a confirmed shipment.
